author: 许丙南
boundary_note: The six cases below are paraphrased from the listed official public pages and used only to compare mechanisms. They do not assert a partnership, local performance, legal equivalence or implementation commitment for Jing-Zhang.

cases.name: City of Helsinki AI Register
cases.mechanism: Public inventory of city AI systems with detailed descriptions and feedback.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Public status board for each pilot: purpose, data boundary, accountable lead, current state and complaint route.
cases.do_not_copy: A register does not replace accessibility, safety, procurement or resident consent review.

cases.name: Amsterdam Algorithm Register
cases.mechanism: Municipal explanation of algorithm use in city services, alongside a Civic AI Lab context.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Publish a plain-language record before a public-space AI test and link it to the review, stop and redress path.
cases.do_not_copy: Do not present a foreign register as Chinese legal compliance or disclose protected operational details without review.

cases.name: Singapore AI Verify / AI Verify Foundation
cases.mechanism: Standardised AI testing, open-source collaboration and an assurance sandbox for technical testing.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Turn the Zhongzhi Garden test room into a booked, human-led assurance window with model card, test note and rollback.
cases.do_not_copy: A toolkit or sandbox is not certification, procurement approval or permission to test residents without consent.

cases.name: Decidim Barcelona
cases.mechanism: Open collaborative participation infrastructure connecting transparent, traceable digital and face-to-face processes.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Pair the contribution wall and online ledger with staffed paper, walk-in and multilingual routes; publish what changed.
cases.do_not_copy: Digital participation cannot stand in for people without accounts, devices, language access or safe meeting conditions.

cases.name: UK Algorithmic Transparency Recording Standard
cases.mechanism: A standardised public record of why and how algorithmic tools are used.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Use a compact preflight record for purpose, owner, data, human review, alternatives, limits, incidents and update date.
cases.do_not_copy: The UK standard is not a Beijing statutory requirement; local authority and legal review must define the final record.

cases.name: Seoul AI Foundation
cases.mechanism: A city-level institutional capacity covering research, public-service application, talent development and global collaboration.
cases.jingzhang_transfer: Treat the belt as a small, accountable interface among research, talent, public service and global exchange, with named responsibility rather than a vague innovation hub.
cases.do_not_copy: Do not imply an institutional partnership, funding or city-level mandate for the Jing-Zhang proposal.

rows.borrow: Treat a station approach as a civic room with rest, wayfinding, care and complaint access.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not copy a commercial branding or assume station ownership permits public programming.
rows.jingzhang_test: Four-quadrant pedestrian continuity and staffed status board at Dazhongsi.

rows.borrow: Use a short, booked test window with a named safety lead, a stop gate and a public post-test note.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not turn residents into unconsenting test subjects or retain individual trajectories.
rows.jingzhang_test: Low-speed delivery robot and red-team sandbox at Zhongzhi Garden.

rows.borrow: Make shade, infiltration, seating and maintenance work orders one visible public system.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not hide drainage capacity behind a sensor dashboard or decorative planting claim.
rows.jingzhang_test: Rainwater tree-pit unit with pre-storm and post-storm checks.

rows.borrow: Publish questions, contributions, model cards and decisions in a durable commons.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not use open-source language to bypass IP, procurement, security or community consent.
rows.jingzhang_test: Open publishing room and contribution wall at the AI Origin Community.

rows.borrow: Keep a low-glare, low-noise, step-free night route for carers, workers and older residents.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not equate more lighting, cameras or event density with safety.
rows.jingzhang_test: Quiet chain, audible/tactile wayfinding and human night patrol.

rows.borrow: Use engineering questions, repair traces and public contribution as a living cultural narrative.
rows.do_not_copy: Do not reproduce historical images, logos or quotations without explicit clearance.
rows.jingzhang_test: Engineering question wall, contribution archive and responsibility desk.
